name: ClawFileServer
description: Browse, preview, and edit files over HTTP on the Gateway port — directory listings, media previews, and a conflict-safe text editor.

basePath.description: URL path prefix mounted on the Gateway HTTP port.

roots.description: Directory trees to expose. Empty defaults to the agent workspace in read-write mode. mode=rw enables upload, mkdir, and editing.

token.description: Optional read-only share token. GET/HEAD requests with ?t=<token> or x-cfs-token header bypass basic auth (reads only). For dashboard widgets and preview links.

auth.description: Route-level auth. 'none' relies on Gateway/network protection; 'basic' adds HTTP basic auth (a password is generated and logged once if unset).

workspace.description: Default root used when 'roots' is empty. Defaults to the OpenClaw workspace directory.
